=== Morphological Assessment Form ===
A. Leaf Arrangement & Architecture

B. Leaf Complexity
    3.	Leaf complexity (simple / compound): simple (each leaf is a single blade without division into leaflets)
    4.	Compound leaf type, ONLY if leaf complexity is compound (odd-pinnate / even-pinnate): N/A

    6.	Leaflet arrangement (opposite / alternate / subopposite): N/A
C. Leaf Morphology
    7.	Leaf margin (entire / toothed) AND if toothed (dentate, serrate, etc.)): entire (the leaf margins are smooth and continuous without teeth or serrations)
    8.	Leaf shape (elliptic, obovate, lanceolate, etc.): elliptic (leaves are widest in the middle and taper towards both ends)

    10.	Leaf base (rounded, cordate, cuneate): cuneate (the leaf base tapers to a wedge-like shape where it attaches to the petiole)
    11.	Venation type (pinnate / palmate / parallel): pinnate (a single midrib runs from base to apex with lateral veins branching off)

    15.	Petiole length (short / long): short (the petioles are noticeably shorter than the leaf blade length)

D. Stem & Shoot Traits
    17.	Stem type, may not be visible (woody / herbaceous): woody (the stem appears stiff, brown, and lignified)
    18.	Stem trichomes (present / absent): absent (the stem surface appears smooth without visible hairs)

    20.	Stem texture (smooth / ridged / lenticellate): smooth (the stem surface does not show obvious ridges or lenticels)
E. Other Visible Seedling Traits
